html:
[Hypothesis]

  • \(f\) (binary relation)
  • \(A\) (set)
  • \(B\) (set)
  • \(A_0 \subseteq A\) (定义域子集)
  • \(x \in A\) (函数自变量)
  • \(y \in B\) (函数值)
  • \(\mathrm{Function}(f, A, B)\) (函数谓词)
  • \(\mathrm{dom}(f)\) (定义域)
  • \(\operatorname{ran}(f)\) (值域)

[Assertion]

[Remark]

  • Function application is identified with membership in the graph of \(f\).
  • The restriction \(f\upharpoonright A_0\) agrees with \(f\) on every \(x\in A_0\).

math.tex: \mathrm{df\text{-}function} \vdash \mathrm{Function}(f,A,B)\leftrightarrow A,B\in V\land f\subseteq A\times B\land\forall x\in A\;\exists!y\in B\;(\langle x,y\rangle\in f)
\mathrm{df\text{-}function\text{-}application} \vdash \mathrm{Function}(f,A,B)\land x\in A\to\forall y\in B\;\bigl(f(x)=y\leftrightarrow\langle x,y\rangle\in f\bigr)
\mathrm{df\text{-}function\text{-}image} \vdash \mathrm{Function}(f,A,B)\land A_0\subseteq A\to f[A_0]\coloneqq\{y\in B:\exists x\in A_0\;(\langle x,y\rangle\in f)\}
\mathrm{df\text{-}function\text{-}restriction} \vdash \mathrm{Function}(f,A,B)\land A_0\subseteq A\to f\upharpoonright A_0\coloneqq f\cap(A_0\times B)
